title: SpaceX discloses $60bn all-stock deal to acquire Cursor maker Anysphere
summary: A June 16 Form 8-K says SpaceX will buy Anysphere for about $60bn in stock, closing in Q3 pending regulatory approval, exercising an April option; announced days after its IPO.

title: Sakana Fugu: One Model to Command Them All
summary: Tokyo-based Sakana AI released Fugu and Fugu Ultra, a model trained to orchestrate frontier models (GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.8) behind a single API; Ultra claims parity with Fable 5 and Mythos Preview.

title: Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models as Anthropic's export ban drags on
summary: Following a US order barring non-Americans from Anthropic's Mythos and Fable 5, Sakana AI and China's 360 (Tulongfeng) pitched alternatives free of export-control risk.

title: Razorpay files confidential DRHP with SEBI for India IPO
summary: Indian payments/fintech software company Razorpay submitted a confidential draft prospectus to SEBI on 12 June 2026; reported raise of about Rs 5,000-6,000 crore, listing late 2026 or early 2027.

title: Persistent Systems bids EUR 81 a share for Nagarro in about EUR 1.3bn takeover
summary: India's Persistent Systems offered EUR 81 a share for Germany's Nagarro (digital engineering), a 140% premium; EV reported EUR 1.27-1.4bn, bridge-funded by Barclays. Shareholders approved 3 Aug; close targeted Q4 CY26/Q1 CY27.

title: Patsnap confidentially files for Hong Kong and Singapore dual IPO
summary: Singapore-based IP and patent analytics software firm Patsnap, backed by HongShan, SoftBank and Tencent, filed confidentially for a dual listing seeking $300-400m at a valuation above $2bn; listing possible late 2026.
